profile.name: Adarsh Shukla
profile.role: Full Stack Developer | Building Tools That Solve Real Problems
profile.bio: I'm a Full Stack Developer passionate about building modern, scalable web applications that solve real-world problems. I enjoy transforming ideas into intuitive digital experiences while writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

projects.title: InspectUI
projects.description: InspectUI is a Chrome extension that helps developers inspect, understand, and recreate modern web interfaces. It combines live UI inspection, frontend technology detection, Tailwind CSS generation, accessibility auditing, and AI-powered implementation guidance in a single workflow.

projects.title: AKTU HUB
projects.description: AKTU Hub is a web-based student platform that provides a centralized system for accessing notes, previous year question papers (PYQs), syllabus, results, and academic tools through a single user-friendly interface. It helps students save time and improve productivity.

projects.title: Weather App
projects.description: Real-time weather application with location-based forecasts and beautiful UI animations.
